best_idea: Decide zone lifecycle from idle time (dormant at 60 s, unload at 300 s, keep-alive never unloads) and tick zones in spacing-based shards largest first, applying every cross-shard move once after the pass instead of inside it.
decision_why: Keep the idle-based dormancy and unload with a keep-alive flag, spacing-based shards narrower when dormant and the deferred cross-shard handoff; fix the wake-without-regroup gap, never drop a handoff, take fight-step timing from the drop-on-overrun pacer, and make idle thresholds per-zone data.
acceptance: A server test loads 700 zone records, idles two zones past 60 s and one past 300 s, and asserts that a keep-alive zone is never unloaded, that a zone woken from dormancy joins a neighbour at distance 3 into one shard, and that every cross-shard move is applied exactly once after the tick pass.
